title: Concept: Play development error page
description: A Play framework error page from development mode in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The page prints the route, the controller source excerpt and the configuration it loaded, which is a guided tour of the server internals.
applicability: Deployments that render a Play framework error page from development mode into a customer- or partner-facing response.
